verses.original: Σὺ δὲ λάλει ἃ πρέπει τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Sy de lalei ha prepei tē hygiainousē didaskalia
verses.literal: But as for you speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, fala o que convém à sã doutrina.

verses.original: Πρεσβύτας νηφαλίους εἶναι σεμνούς σώφρονας ὑγιαίνοντας τῇ πίστει τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ
verses.transliteration: Presbytas nēphalious einai semnous sōphronas hygiainontas tē pistei tē agapē tē hypomonē
verses.literal: Older men are to be temperate dignified self-controlled and sound in faith love and perseverance
verses.literalPt: Exorta os velhos a que sejam sóbrios, circunspectos, prudentes, sãos na fé, no amor e na perseverança;

verses.original: πρεσβύτιδας ὡσαύτως ἐν καταστήματι ἱεροπρεπεῖς μὴ διαβόλους μηδὲ οἴνῳ πολλῷ δεδουλωμένας καλοδιδασκάλους
verses.transliteration: presbytidas hōsautōs en katastēmati hieroprepeis mē diabolous mēde oinō pollō dedoulōmenas kalodidaskalous
verses.literal: Older women likewise are to be reverent in their behavior not slanderers or addicted to much wine but teachers of good
verses.literalPt: da mesma maneira, as velhas, a que sejam de compostura reverente, não maldizentes, não dadas ao excesso no uso do vinho, a que ensinem o bem,

verses.original: ἵνα σωφρονίζωσιν τὰς νέας φιλάνδρους εἶναι φιλοτέκνους
verses.transliteration: hina sōphronizōsin tas neas philandrous einai philoteknous
verses.literal: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children
verses.literalPt: para que instruam as mulheres moças a amarem seus maridos e seus filhos,

verses.original: σώφρονας ἁγνάς οἰκουργούς ἀγαθάς ὑποτασσομένας τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ἵνα μὴ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ βλασφημῆται
verses.transliteration: sōphronas hagnas oikourgous agathas hypotassomenas tois idiois andrasin hina mē ho logos tou Theou blasphēmētai
verses.literal: to be self-controlled pure managers of their households kind and submissive to their own husbands so that the word of God will not be discredited
verses.literalPt: a serem prudentes, castas, cuidadosas da casa, bondosas, sujeitas a seus maridos a fim de que a palavra de Deus não seja blasfemada.

verses.literal: In the same way urge the younger men to be self-controlled
verses.literalPt: Exorta também os moços a que sejam prudentes em tudo

verses.original: Περὶ πάντα σεαυτὸν παρεχόμενος τύπον καλῶν ἔργων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀφθορίαν σεμνότητα
verses.transliteration: Peri panta seauton parechomenos typon kalōn ergōn en tē didaskalia aphthorian semnotēta
verses.literal: In everything show yourself to be an example by doing good works In your teaching show integrity dignity
verses.literalPt: e faze-te a ti mesmo um exemplo de boas obras; na tua doutrina, mostrando integridade, seriedade

verses.original: λόγον ὑγιῆ ἀκατάγνωστον ἵνα ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐντραπῇ μηδὲν ἔχων λέγειν περὶ ἡμῶν φαῦλον
verses.transliteration: logon hygiē akatagnōston hina ho ex enantias entrapē mēden echōn legein peri hēmōn phaulon
verses.literal: and wholesome speech that is above reproach so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed having nothing bad to say about us
verses.literalPt: e linguagem sã e irrepreensível, para que o adversário se confunda, não tendo mal algum que dizer de nós.

verses.original: Δούλους ἰδίοις δεσπόταις ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἐν πᾶσιν εὐαρέστους εἶναι μὴ ἀντιλέγοντας
verses.transliteration: Doulous idiois despotais hypotassesthai en pasin euarestous einai mē antilegontas
verses.literal: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything to be well-pleasing not argumentative
verses.literalPt: Exorta os servos a que sejam sujeitos a seus senhores, que lhes sejam agradáveis em tudo;

verses.original: μὴ νοσφιζομένους ἀλλὰ πᾶσαν πίστιν ἐνδεικνυμένους ἀγαθήν ἵνα τὴν διδασκαλίαν τὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ κοσμῶσιν ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: mē nosphizomenous alla pasan pistin endeiknymenous agathēn hina tēn didaskalian tēn tou Sōtēros hēmōn Theou kosmōsin en pasin
verses.literal: not stealing from them but showing all good faith so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior
verses.literalPt: e que não os contradigam, que não os defraudem, mas que lhes manifestem em tudo perfeita fidelidade, a fim de que em tudo honrem a doutrina de Deus, nosso Salvador.

verses.original: Ἐπεφάνη γὰρ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Epephanē gar hē charis tou Theou sōtērios pasin anthrōpois
verses.literal: For the grace of God has appeared bringing salvation to everyone . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois a graça de Deus se manifestou, trazendo a salvação a todos os homens,

verses.original: παιδεύουσα ἡμᾶς ἵνα ἀρνησάμενοι τὴν ἀσέβειαν καὶ τὰς κοσμικὰς ἐπιθυμίας σωφρόνως καὶ δικαίως καὶ εὐσεβῶς ζήσωμεν ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι
verses.transliteration: paideuousa hēmas hina arnēsamenoi tēn asebeian kai tas kosmikas epithymias sōphronōs kai dikaiōs kai eusebōs zēsōmen en tō nyn aiōni
verses.literal: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions and to live sensible upright and godly lives in the present age
verses.literalPt: ensinando-nos, a fim de que, renunciando a impiedade e as paixões mundanas, vivamos no presente mundo sóbria, reta e piamente,

verses.original: προσδεχόμενοι τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: prosdechomenoi tēn makarian elpida kai epiphaneian tēs doxēs tou megalou Theou kai Sōtēros hēmōn Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: aguardando a bem-aventurada esperança e a manifestação da glória do grande Deus e nosso Salvador Cristo Jesus,

verses.original: ὃς ἔδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα λυτρώσηται ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἑαυτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον ζηλωτὴν καλῶν ἔργων
verses.transliteration: hos edōken heauton hyper hēmōn hina lytrōsētai hēmas apo pasēs anomias kai katharisē heautō laon periousion zēlōtēn kalōn ergōn
verses.literal: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession zealous for good deeds
verses.literalPt: que se deu a si mesmo por nós, a fim de nos remir de toda iniquidade e purificar para si um povo todo seu, zeloso de boas obras.

verses.original: Ταῦτα λάλει καὶ παρακάλει καὶ ἔλεγχε μετὰ πάσης ἐπιταγῆς μηδείς σου περιφρονείτω
verses.transliteration: Tauta lalei kai parakalei kai elenche meta pasēs epitagēs mēdeis sou periphroneitō
verses.literal: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority Let no one despise you
verses.literalPt: Fala essas coisas, exorta e repreende com toda a autoridade. Ninguém te despreze.
